_comment: Pinned dependency manifest for reproducible builds (modular_proposal.md 12.1). Surfaced in --version / GUI About and release notes; consumed by scripts/fetch-deps.ps1 and scripts/build-whisper-dlls.ps1. Bump here when a dependency is updated.

whisper._role: ASR engine, built to backend-DL DLLs by scripts/build-whisper-dlls.ps1

cuda._role: CUDA runtime shipped in the NVIDIA GPU pack (cudart/cublas/cublasLt); users need only an NVIDIA driver

vulkan._role: GPU pack backend; end users need only their GPU driver's vulkan-1.dll. SDK is build-machine only.

ffmpeg._role: demux/decode any container -> PCM (audio path only). BtbN LGPL shared.

onnxruntime._role: MDX-Net vocal isolation via the DirectML execution provider (any DX12 GPU). Fetched from NuGet (the DirectML build is NOT published as a GitHub release asset).

directml._role: DirectML runtime (DirectML.dll) paired with the ONNX Runtime DirectML EP. Fetched from NuGet.
